user_story: As a user, I want to set a priority level on a task so that I know what to work on first.

positive.title: Set Priority to High
steps: Set the priority level to High.
positive.expected_result: The task's priority level is set to High.

positive.title: Set Priority to Medium
steps: Set the priority level to Medium.
positive.expected_result: The task's priority level is set to Medium.

negative.title: Attempt to Set Empty Priority
steps: Attempt to set the priority level to ' ' (blank).
negative.expected_result: The system displays an error message indicating that priority level cannot be blank.

negative.title: Invalid Priority Level
steps: Attempt to set the priority level to 'Urgent' (an invalid input).
negative.expected_result: The system displays an error message indicating that 'Urgent' is not a valid priority level.

edge.title: Set Priority With Maximum Input Length
steps: Set the priority level to 'High' with 255 characters allowed by the input field.
edge.expected_result: The system saves the priority correctly, indicating that it can handle the maximum input length.

edge.title: Set Priority Rapidly
steps: Quickly set the priority level from Low to Medium to High in rapid succession.
edge.expected_result: The system correctly saves the final priority level as High, demonstrating it can handle rapid sequential changes.
